text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are likely to be mixed on Thursday with active buying and selling expected from small investors, brokers said.
"The market may move steadily with both buying and selling. The market position is sound, but the investors may still be cautious (with) fresh commitments," said one broker.

Blue chip leather, pharmaceuticals and cement shares might rise as investors focus on sectors with strong economic fundamentals, he said. The DSE benchmark index rose 6.97 points or 0.62 percent to 1,115.99 on turnover of 54.2 million taka on Wedndesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom + 880-2-506363
